name: type-confusion
description: Request validation layer that gates on the API version and resolves feature flags from parsed query parameters.

bugs.description: isSupportedVersion compares version with loose equality, so the string '2' from a query parameter is coerced to the number 2 and silently accepted.
isEnabled compares a boolean flag against the string 'true' with strict equality, so the true branch is dead and every enabled flag reports false.
